title: Activity
attach_title: Attach a file. You can also paste or drop one in the box.
post_failed_detail: Could not post the comment: {error}. Your text is still here.
empty_system: Nothing has happened to this task yet.

notify.off_title: This run doesn't take live messages: it may be an agent image older than the conversation channel, an engine without streaming input, or the daemon restarted while it was running.
notify.on_title: It arrives as a message in the conversation the agent is already having. It reads it when the current turn ends; it doesn't interrupt it.
notify.not_delivered: The comment stayed in the thread without notifying the agent

threads.label: Thread started by {who}
threads.applied: Thread sent to the stage's agent
threads.reply_failed_detail: Could not post the reply: {error}. Your text is still here.
threads.placeholder_to: Reply in this thread… (goes to @{agent} unless you @mention someone)
threads.placeholder_none: Reply in this thread… (@agent to call one)

run_log_missing: This run's log is not on the Timeline yet
stop_message: The agent stops where it is. Its work so far stays in the branch and the task stays in its stage.
wait_canceled: The run will not start. Relaunch the stage to put it back in the queue.
cancel_wait_message: The run of {agent} in {stage} leaves the queue and does not start; the task goes back to how it was before the wait. To undo it, use {relaunch}: the run goes back in the queue.
cancel_wait_message_nostage: The run of {agent} leaves the queue and does not start; the task goes back to how it was before the wait. To undo it, use {relaunch}: the run goes back in the queue.
